soc.transfers.measurement: Squad component, per club and transfer window: dV = ln(sum of Transfermarkt market values of the 14 players with most expected minutes after the window) - ln(same before the window); rating shift = b_V x dV, with b_V fitted on window-to-window changes of the goal-rate rating across 10 seasons of top-league clubs and shrunk toward 0 with k=200 club-windows. Manager component: flag mc=1 from the officially announced appointment date of a new permanent or caretaker head coach; m = league matches played under him; rating used for remaining fixtures = w(m) x (pre-change rating + d_mc) + (1 - w(m)) x rating estimated only from matches under the new manager, with w(m) = 6/(6+m); d_mc = event-study post-change shift (default 0, since much of the bounce is regression to the mean). As-of: only transfers registered and appointments announced before the pricing timestamp.
raw_data: player market values by date (pre and post window)
registered transfers and loans with dates
head-coach appointments and exits with official dates

soc.weather.measurement: Pull the hourly forecast issued before the as-of time for venue latitude/longitude at kickoff, +1h and +2h: temperature (C), relative humidity (%), wind speed and gust (m/s), precipitation (mm). Derive heat index (Steadman/NWS formula) averaged over the two halves and take venue altitude (m) from the stadium table. Fit with league fixed effects and kickoff-hour controls: (a) total goals and shot quality on wind, precipitation, heat index and altitude; (b) second-half share of goals on heat index and altitude. Set all effects to 0 for roofed stadiums when the roof is closed; flag artificial pitches separately.
raw_data: hourly forecast and archive weather at venue coordinates (temperature, humidity, wind, gust, precipitation)
stadium table: coordinates, altitude, roof, pitch type

soc.home_advantage.measurement: Estimate league-season home advantage from the Dixon-Coles home parameter; team-specific deviation as a random effect shrunk with k ~ 40 home matches; apply as goal-rate multipliers for both teams, not a win-probability offset. Venue rule: full value when the club plays at its own ground; 0 at neutral venues (venue country and city differ from both teams); in international tournaments a host nation playing in its own country receives the national-team home multiplier estimated from home competitive internationals (shrunk to the club-league mean with k=60 matches), and 0 for its matches abroad (2026 World Cup: USA, Mexico and Canada each play group matches at home).
